title: Crypt
summary: Secret-trading game with a wallet-free simulation and an experimental Sapient path. The creator’s October 31 reviewed forum entry identifies ogboy92ii/crypt as the full-history mirror of the restricted Lrifton92/crypt repository; the replacement demo and earlier source archive remain available. BSD-3-Clause source. The mirrored ON-CHAIN · SAPIENT screen warns that 15 testnet XTM remain in settled escrow because the browser wallet cannot sign the Rust SDK stealth payout; reloading mid-sale abandons the session. Disputes reveal secrets and public metadata remains visible. The October 29 recording shows the mirror’s requirements and title screen, with no wallet or transaction. Earlier simulation footage and retired URLs remain in the maintenance history.
